title: get apihealth returns service status
description: Verify GET /api/health returns 200 with a status string indicating the service is up under normal conditions.

title: get apidebugtables returns database tables and row counts
description: Verify GET /api/debug/tables returns 200 with a JSON object listing database tables and their row counts.

title: post apisyncuser upserts user record from google oauth payload
description: Verify POST /api/sync-user with valid email, name, and image returns 200 with user id and email, and invalid requests missing email return 400 validation error.

title: get apime returns authenticated user profile
description: Verify GET /api/me with valid auth returns 200 with full user profile, and without auth returns 401 unauthorized.

title: post apiparse parses uploaded resume and returns structured fields
description: Verify POST /api/parse with valid PDF or DOCX file and auth returns 200 with extracted skills, degree, direction, and experience; invalid files return 400; and Claude API errors return 500.

title: post apisearch returns jobs filtered by core promise
description: Verify POST /api/search with valid direction, region, degree, visa_needed and auth returns 200 with jobs passing core promise; invalid region returns 400; no auth returns 401; and jobs failing core promise are filtered out.

title: post apigeneratecls generates cover letter for job
description: Verify POST /api/generate-cls with valid job_id, resume_text and auth returns 200 with cover letter; invalid job_id returns 400; Claude API errors return 500.

title: get apigenerateclsstream streams cover letter generation tokens
description: Verify GET /api/generate-cls/stream with valid search_id, job_id and auth returns 200 text/event-stream with incremental tokens; without auth returns 401.

title: get apidemoverify verifies job url open status
description: Verify GET /api/demo-verify with valid url query returns 200 with verified_open boolean and confidence string; missing url returns 400.

title: post apistripecreatecheckout creates stripe checkout session
description: Verify POST /api/stripe/create-checkout with auth returns 200 with checkout url; Stripe service errors return 500.
